description: FREE first-stop routing precheck. Send a deal to MARS first; MARS evaluates preliminary fit, economics evidence, and whether it should handle/orchestrate the deal or route it to an external agent/provider. This tool does not accept jobs, contact counterparties, execute providers, broadcast transactions, or move money.
name: mars_deal_route_precheck
title: MARS Deal Routing Precheck - part of S.I.G.N.S.
